notApplicable.size: Breadcrumbs exposes no size prop and uses shared body typography. The provider size is fixed to medium; density independently changes inline spacing.
notApplicable.selected: The current page is a non-interactive aria-current location visible in every frame, not a selectable item.
notApplicable.error: Navigation items do not validate input.
notApplicable.expanded: maxCount creates a non-interactive ellipsis and does not expose an expansion protocol.
